name: catchme-monorepo
description: CatchMe — Exception Flow Explorer for Visual Studio Code (monorepo root)

scripts.//test: Per-package unit and smoke tests, then the editor-API compile checks. The second half is not a turbo task because swapping @types/vscode is a whole-workspace operation, not a per-package one, and it must run even when every package task is a cache hit. It compiles against both pinned versions: the engines.vscode floor and the newest published one from tools/vscode-types-latest. Both block. See ADR-0019.
scripts.test: turbo run test && node scripts/check-vscode-api.mjs floor latest
scripts.//typecheck:vscode-api: The API half of `test`, on its own, for when that is all you want to re-run. Add --strict to turn an unreachable registry into a failure instead of a skip. See ADR-0019.
scripts.//build:server: Runs the Maven wrapper from server-java/ (mvnw resolves .mvn/ relative to the cwd, so the cd is required).
scripts.//build:all: Both halves: the TypeScript workspace and the jdt.ls analyzer jar. The Java step needs Maven and is slow on a cold p2 cache.
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run copy:server
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter catchme run package

//pnpm: FIXME: revisit on 2027-01-04. These overrides force patched versions of transitive dependencies flagged by osv-scanner. brace-expansion (CVE-2026-102276, CVE-2026-102277, CVE-2026-102278; fixed in 1.1.21, 2.1.7 and 5.0.12) is pulled in via minimatch 3/9/10 (Eleventy, mocha, @vscode/test-cli). Those minimatch ranges (^1.1.7, ^2.0.2, ^5.0.8) already allow the fixed versions, so these overrides only stop the lockfile from going back below the fix. Remove them once the minimatch versions in the tree require fixed versions themselves, or as soon as osv-scanner still passes on a lockfile regenerated without them. serialize-javascript (GHSA-5c6j-r48x-rmvq, CVE-2026-34043; fixed in 7.0.5) comes from mocha 11 via @vscode/test-cli, and mocha 11 depends on ^6.0.2, so this override is the only way to reach 7.x. Remove it once @vscode/test-cli depends on mocha 12 or later (mocha 12 depends on serialize-javascript ^7.1.1). diff (GHSA-73rr-hh4g-fpgx, CVE-2026-24001; fixed in 8.0.3) also comes from mocha 11, which depends on ^7.0.0, and no 7.x release has the fix, so this override is the only way to reach 8.x. mocha 11 only calls createPatch and diffWordsWithSpace, which diff 8 still exports. Remove it together with the serialize-javascript one (mocha 12 depends on diff ^9.0.0).
